title: The chain-link
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Monday. Two days before. Wood walks the dog past the Lanes and doesn't go round back. The dog pulls toward the alley. Wood says Wednesday. The dog doesn't know Wednesday. He pulls. Wood holds. The strip draws the leash tight.

panels.composition: The bowling alley across 101 at dusk, the sign lit, all letters. WOOD in the chore coat on the far shoulder with BARNABY on the leash, pulling toward the alley.

image.prompt: a bowling alley across a highway at dusk with its neon sign fully lit, a young man in a chore coat holding a leash as a small dog pulls toward the building's side alley, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The leash. Tight. Drawn as a single straight line between the hand and the collar.

image.prompt: close on a taut leash drawn as a single straight line between a hand and a small dog's collar, black and white, no words
a young man in a chore coat holding a taut leash, speaking to a dog, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The two of them walking on, the dog looking back, the alley behind. The sign. Fifteen. Wednesday.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog walking away along a highway shoulder as the dog looks back toward a lit sign, black and white, no words
